description: Beyond Juniors is a team founded by young innovators aged 15-16. We aim to proudly represent our beloved Nasser Centre for Science and Technology while demonstrating that younger participants can make meaningful contributions and achieve remarkable results despite the challenges and disadvantages that often come with our age.
summary: We created a 3D simulation of what an astronaut does to manage themselves on the moon and the possible difficulties/concerns that could occur as an astronaut.
details: Our educational game works by showing accurate details in a fun and engaging way for our youth/younger generations. We used python as a Back-end language and used HTML as a front-end language. our project is creative because it is considerate for beginners in the knowledge of space. We considered keeping the game as realistic as possible due to the possibility of having to over simplify knowledge.
